method: Power capacity is FracTracker mw (589 of 1,733 records give a number), Epoch AI current power, or PNNL projected IT power (36 MW for every modelled site, so it does not separate them). Floor area is FracTracker facility_size_sqft, PNNL atlas campus area or PNNL projected campus size. Dedicated fossil power is 1 when a FracTracker record names gas, coal, oil, diesel, turbines or fracked gas in its power source or dedicated power plant, and 0 otherwise, including when nothing is reported; it has weight 0 in the leaderboard because so few records report it. Vulnerable carbon is Conservation International's 2024 vulnerable carbon (Noon et al. 2022, v2 2025) summed over the site cell: carbon likely lost if the land is cleared. Cooling energy demand is PNNL projected only. Grid emissions are not yet included: EPA eGRID emission rates are the largest gap in this pillar. Scores are mid-rank percentiles (0–100) among the facilities in view, with direction applied so a higher percentile means a greater potential impact; tied values share the midpoint of their rank range, and a facility with no value for a variable is left out of that variable's ranking. The pillar score is the plain mean of the variable percentiles. Neighbourhood variables use the H3 res-8 cells (about 0.7 km² each) whose centre lies within the chosen radius of the facility; site variables use the single res-8 cell that holds the facility point. All of this is provisional.
